metadata.case_name: LEE CHUI YING AND ANOTHER v. CHAN YEE LING ELAINE

injuries.description: an ulcer over the right side of the upper lip
source: Examination showed an ulcer over the right side of the upper lip and a 1 cm abrasion over the left side of the nose.

injuries.description: a 1 cm abrasion over the left side of the nose
source: Examination showed an ulcer over the right side of the upper lip and a 1 cm abrasion over the left side of the nose.
The Defendant was diagnosed of post-traumatic stress disorder and prescribed a course of anti-depressant in late October 2011.
Subsequently, she was found to have mild to moderate depressive disorder.
The Defendant received dental treatment for a fractured tooth some two months after the incident.

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities resulting from an ulcer over the right side of the upper lip and a 1 cm abrasion over the left side of the nose (2nd Plaintiff)
Pain, suffering and loss of amenities resulting from post-traumatic stress disorder and mild to moderate depressive disorder (Defendant)

The Defendant was diagnosed of post-traumatic stress disorder and prescribed a course of anti-depressant in late October 2011. Subsequently, she was found to have mild to moderate depressive disorder.
